title: The acceptance self-check could not complete without the locked dependencies

original.cause: Its language-regression step runs scripts/generate-userscript-language-data.mjs, which failed with "Cannot find module 'vite'" because the locked dependencies were absent and pnpm was not installed on this host.

resolution: Node v22.23.3 was downloaded from nodejs.org with its tarball SHA-256 checked against the official SHASUMS256.txt, pnpm 9.12.1 was installed into the round directory with that Node npm, both were exposed through PATH only, and pnpm install --frozen-lockfile was run in the healthy tools clone. No build was performed.
